key.title: Ballot encryption key
key.subtitle: Ballots are stored encrypted. Only the private key file you keep can open them at counting time.
key.none: No key has been set yet. Create one before voting opens.
key.locked: Voting has started, so the key can no longer be changed.
key.step1: Generate a key pair. This happens in your browser; nothing is sent yet.
key.step2: Download the private key file and keep it safe (for example on two USB drives).
key.step3: Upload the public key. The private key never leaves your computer.
key.warning: If the private key file is lost, the ballots cannot be counted. The server does not keep a copy.
key.confirm: I have saved the private key file somewhere safe.
key.saved: The public key is saved. Ballots will be encrypted with it.
key.browserError: This browser cannot generate the key. Please use a recent Chrome, Firefox, Edge or Safari.

settings.title: System settings
settings.subtitle: Change login, session and email settings without a code change. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.locked: Voting is open, so settings cannot be changed until it closes.

otp.cooldownMinutes: Lockout after too many wrong codes

rateLimit.otpPerRegNoPerHour: Code requests per registration number, per hour
rateLimit.otpPerIpPer15Minutes: Code requests per network, per 15 minutes
rateLimit.loginPerIpPer15Minutes: Login attempts per network, per 15 minutes

notify.reminderHoursBeforeClose: Send the reminder this long before voting closes

notify.title: Election emails
notify.subtitle: Emails go to every eligible voter when voting opens, as a reminder to those who have not voted, and when results are published.
notify.summary: {{all}} eligible voters, {{notVoted}} have not voted yet. Emails go out {{batch}} at a time, every {{seconds}} seconds.
notify.disabled: The email job is switched off on this server (NOTIFY_ENABLED=false).
notify.consoleTransport: This server prints emails to its log instead of sending them (MAIL_TRANSPORT=console).
notify.subject: Subject:

observer.title: Observer dashboard
observer.subtitle: Read-only view of turnout, system status and the audit log. No personal voter data is shown here.
observer.turnoutMissing: Live turnout will appear here once the turnout service is ready.
observer.refreshes: Refreshes every 10 seconds. Candidate vote counts are never shown before voting closes.
observer.verifyMissing: The integrity check will be available once the audit verification service is ready.
observer.verifyOk: The audit log is intact ({{n}} entries checked).
observer.verifyBroken: The audit log has been changed: first bad entry #{{id}}.
